component.name: LinFileCopy
component.summary: Copy and sync folders between local disks and external drives

description.p: LinFileCopy is a dashboard for copy and sync jobs between internal disks, USB sticks, external drives and local storage arrays, powered by rsync. Design a job with a clear form, preview exactly what will change, run it, watch live progress and get notified when it finishes. You never have to type an rsync command, but the exact command is always shown.

ul.li: Copy, mirror, or keep two folders in step in both directions
Preview every change before anything is copied or deleted
Adapts to the drive's filesystem (exFAT, FAT32, NTFS) and ejects it when done
Hard-linked snapshots, atomic replace, resume, checksums and speed limits
Unlocks encrypted drives, runs on a schedule, on file changes or when a drive is plugged in
History with logs, plain-language errors and one-click retry
